description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git operations involving case-insensitive file systems, specifically testing how git handles renames that change the case of filenames in such environments.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for required prerequisites before running the tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, executes a set of commands, and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.
